_comment: Release-Chapter ledger (SoftDisk model) -- NOT the same 'chapter' as book_lore.json's 12 sequence entries. All 12 of those are part of release Chapter 1. This ledger tracks whole-release-chapter lock/unlock state; 'covers' lists which book_lore ids are bundled into that release chapter. mode=chapters computes publicly_released per book-lore id by checking whether any release_chapters entry with released=true covers that id -- the whole chapter unlocks together, not entry by entry. min_engine_version is the ZenZork script version (see file header) required for this chapter's content to actually function -- a bundle can introduce unlock TYPES the current engine doesn't have a dispatcher for yet (new quest types, new genie-code types, etc), so a chapter can be 'released' as content while still being gated on an engine upgrade landing first. Check this before assuming a released chapter is playable.
_releases_comment: v2 release-identity ledger (ZenZork v2 Story 1, ticket #10563) -- deliberately separate from release_chapters above, which stays untouched (its released flag and covers list still drive the book_lore catch-up mechanism as-is). This ledger just names eras for episode-gating going forward: the existing shipped game is 'prologue' (already released, no replay), the next content drop is 'episode_01' (not yet released). Engine-version compatibility stays exclusively on release_chapters/_engine_version -- this ledger does not duplicate that.
